# FG-SA stage-4 semantic dependency ledger

Base: df5ca51; comparison D=d35bac1 and J4=bc42cff (stage-3 ledger).
V2Manifest hashes come from the checked-in FGSA-API / GEN-API at each revision.
Source evidence: `git log -p d35bac1..HEAD --` all four statement/claim trees
(6567 lines), including 8d2fa1a, 494baf3, 9daa3dd, 58a125c, bc42cff,
048dbf0, ea441d6, 4795c9c, f24ba8f, 03dada4, 6ca9794, cd285ae and 858f371.
The final S4.5 manifest check is recorded below after Part B.

Hash equality is not semantic equality. This census includes public fields
and equations. It also includes unchanged run claims that read W stores,
client inputs or admission through public model dependencies. Broad dependent
rows do not claim that every Boolean result changed: they state the changed
model under which the predicate is interpreted. SAME marks a bridge-equal read.
New interfaces are additive even when they express an INTENTIONAL W contract.

The stage-3 ledger remains binding: Reachable/epochs now use W admission;
CStoreInv/Inv0 use W finality; RFrame selects R6W against one common parent;
RCert/RQCOrigin use W carrier certificates; fgInputs reads W h_F; stale R6W
does not imply HeightMatch. J_mem/store_accountable are safe through finalityView.
certified retains its set content (W F is under J); do not infer set change
from the implementation port. H-only controls and frame geometry remain equal.

Public API audit rows: 1374.
